summary: Beaver Mountain lookout site in the Central Kootenay region, BC; a 1939 item mentions its trail and vandals burned the lookout in 1999.

facts.status_note: Burned by vandals in 1999, according to Canada's Fire Lookouts; no source read describes the site now.

events.note: Province newspaper item on a summer forest-programme crew working on the Beaver Mountain lookout trail. It concerns the trail, not a build date for the tower.

evidence.supports: Lookout site in the Central Kootenay region
Position and elevation as given on the page (no unit)
Earliest dated item on the page: 1939
1939 item: crew of ten men on the Beaver Mountain lookout trail
evidence.quote: One project of a crew of ten men will work on the Beaver Mountain lookout trail.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the Canada's Fire Lookouts page for Beaver Mountain. It gives no build date, design, staffing or access. The 1939 item concerns a crew working on the lookout trail, so it is not a build date. Location conflict: the record's BC base map point (TRIM symbol 17110, 49.14911, -117.43976) is about 500 m from the page's coordinates (49.15, -117.433). The story quotes only the page. The page's elevation of 1959 has no unit; the record stores it as metres, which is unverified. Facebook group posts found in search (not readable here) mention a 'Beaver L/O' on Mt Kelly near Trail and a 'Beaver Mountain LO near Fruitvale BC in about 1995'. They may describe this tower, a different one, or the same one under another name; check before linking any of them. The story names the region as 'Central Kootenay region', the page's own label; the page names no regional district.
